purpose: Plan 01 software completion, tested on the recorded mock host; owner acceptance and external gates remain open. Provider interface revision 2 binds the updated cell observation, project and recipe contracts; a simulation/hardware provider must verify these hashes and supply its own evidence. Plan 02 (2026-11-05) adds the simulation layer in source: world compiler, Gazebo/Nav2 worker bridge, clock barrier, telemetry ingest, fault schedule, actors/metrics, coffee_io_sim process coupling, cup transfer evidence, the ARM03 swept-path checker, the scenario matrix, LabEvidenceV2 records and SIL campaign tooling. Every SIL run on the recorded macOS host is not_run (no Linux/ROS 2/Gazebo); physics rows carry no pass.
